positions.as_written: On the coronal images, follow the meniscus from front to back: the anterior horn, the body at the mid coronal slice, then the posterior horn, with the peripheral attachment visible at each level.
Assess extrusion, root integrity, rim width and tear location before arthroscopy, and plan for repair wherever those four favour it.
